home.tagline: I design interfaces, build the product behind them, and make sure both hold up under real use.

about.title: About Me
about.bio: I like taking a product from a rough idea to something people can actually click through — sketching the interface, building it, and making sure it doesn't fall apart under real use. Most of that has been on entertainment, finance, and production-scheduling systems, working closely with the people who'll actually use them.

uiux.title: UI/UX Design
uiux.description: Turning ambiguous requirements into interfaces people actually understand — user research, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma, refined through direct collaboration with product managers and non-technical stakeholders.

webdev.title: Web Development
webdev.description: End-to-end product builds with Next.js, React, TypeScript, PHP, and Express — from database schema and REST APIs to polished, responsive interfaces, containerized with Docker and shipped through CI/CD.

qa.title: Quality Assurance
qa.description: Catching what breaks before users do — structured manual test cases with clear priority and expected results, detailed bug reports with screenshots and video, plus automated tests with Jest and Playwright.
